project: SPARTA QRA Cascade Grader GT Labeler

features.name: Load 138 items from data.jsonl
features.check: Page shows 138 total items. First item question text visible.

features.name: Load and merge evidence cases
features.check: Evidence verdict banner shows for current item. Stats: 51 SATISFIED + 87 INCONCLUSIVE.

features.name: 6 filter tabs with correct counts
features.check: Tabs: All(138), Need Review(87), Auto-PASS(51), Auto-FAIL(0), Adversarial(0), Done(0). Clicking filters.

features.name: Progress bar with label count
features.check: Green bar starts at 0/138. Fills proportionally as labels applied.

features.name: Evidence verdict banner (color-coded)
features.check: Green banner for SATISFIED, amber for INCONCLUSIVE. Shows grade (B/C) and score.

features.name: Question text with NVIS entity chips
features.check: Question text renders inline NVIS chips: GREEN (#00FF88) for resolved control IDs with QRA count, RED (#FF4444) for fabricated IDs, AMBER (#FFAA00) for misspellings, YELLOW (#FFE600) for unknown terms. Chips are clickable to show detail.

features.name: Answer text with NVIS entity highlighting
features.check: Answer text shows inline NVIS entity chips. Fabricated control IDs in RED, resolved in GREEN. Claims about non-existent controls are visually obvious.

features.name: Given/Then decomposition panel
features.check: Collapsible panel below question shows Given (context) and Then (targets) components. Each component shows resolution status: green checkmark (resolved + QRA count + technique), red X (fabricated/not in corpus).

features.name: Gate trace pipeline visualization
features.check: Horizontal pipeline showing 6-8 gates: Topic, Recall, Grounding, Technique Bridge, Clarify, Lean4, Plausibility. Each gate shows pass (green), fail (red), or warn (amber). Clickable to expand details.

features.name: Citations with resolved control IDs
features.check: Indigo card with citation text. Control IDs below: green badge (exists + QRA count) or red badge (NOT IN CORPUS).

features.name: Evidence manifest panel
features.check: Shows: grounding_ok, citation_alignment level, answer_in_corpus YES/NO badge, plausibility, recommendation.

features.name: 3 model prediction chips
features.check: Gemini, v7-ckpt63, v9. Green=PASS, red=FAIL. Confidence % shown.

features.name: Majority vote summary
features.check: Shows vote result and agreement count (e.g. FAIL 2/3).

features.name: Evidence auto-label indicator
features.check: SATISFIED items show 'Auto-labeled PASS' badge. INCONCLUSIVE shows 'Needs human judgment'.

features.name: PASS/FAIL/SKIP action buttons
features.check: Large buttons. Active for INCONCLUSIVE. Auto-labeled items show override toggle instead.

features.name: Adversarial toggle
features.check: Toggle to mark adversarial. Purple highlight when active. A key shortcut works.

features.name: Keyboard shortcuts (P/F/S/A/arrows)
features.check: P=Pass, F=Fail, S=Skip, A=Adversarial, Left/Right=Navigate. Hints in bottom bar.

features.name: Bottom sticky navigation bar
features.check: Sticky bar: Prev/Next buttons, position (X/138), keyboard hints. Arrow keys navigate.

features.name: Auto-advance after label
features.check: After PASS/FAIL, advances to next unlabeled item in current filter.

features.name: localStorage persistence
features.check: Labels + adversarial flags survive page reload.

features.name: Export JSONL with all fields
features.check: Downloads JSONL: review_id, qra_id, human_grade, is_adversarial, auto_label_source, evidence_case. 138 lines.

features.name: Auto-PASS tab shows SATISFIED items
features.check: Tab filters to 51 SATISFIED items. Each has PASS pre-filled. Override toggle available.

features.name: NVIS color palette (MIL-STD-3009)
features.check: Entity chips use Embry OS NVIS colors: GREEN=#00FF88, AMBER=#FFAA00, RED=#FF4444, YELLOW=#FFE600. NOT generic Tailwind green/red. Consistent with SentinelHUD palette.

features.name: Dark theme (slate-900)
features.check: No white backgrounds. All text readable. Cards slate-800 on slate-900.

features.name: Two-column layout (60/40)
features.check: Left 60% content+evidence, Right 40% predictions+actions. No overlap at 1920px.

features.name: Technique bridge indicator
features.check: Shows whether Given/Then components share a SPARTA technique. Green if bridge found (e.g. 'Harden 85% coherence'), red if no bridge. Key adversarial signal.
